== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Heartlands represent the birthplace of humanity and were once ruled by [[Nakothi]]. This region is currently governed by Heartlander{{!}}Heartlanders, a people characterized by dark or black skin. The area has experienced periods of intense violence and chaos, though it eventually reached a state of unstable equilibrium following the death of the Emperor. While some suggest the Heartlands could be part of a system where different regions govern themselves, the territory currently lacks a [[Regent]], leading to concerns that the Capital might face anarchy if imperial rule is not reestablished.}}
